The '''4C observation droid''' was a model of [[observation droid]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] employed a 4C model at [[Outpost C-2]] in the [[Carba Asteroid Belt]] in the [[Bacrana system/Legends|Bacrana system]].
